title: Microbial community dynamics of aerobic granular sludge during acidic partial nitritation under low-alkalinity conditions
description: The microbial community dynamics of aerobic granular sludge were investigated in a laboratory-scale sequencing batch reactor operated under low-alkalinity conditions to achieve acidic partial nitritation. Sludge samples were collected at four representative operational stages (Days 0, 20, 43, and 107), including initial inoculation, stable partial nitritation, process destabilization under low ammonium loading, and subsequent recovery of stable partial nitritation. High-throughput sequencing of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene was performed to characterize changes in microbial community composition, with particular emphasis on ammonia-oxidizing bacteria (AOB) and nitrite-oxidizing bacteria (NOB). The sequencing data provide insights into microbial community succession associated with the stability and recovery of acidic partial nitritation under low-alkalinity conditions.
